#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

void build(vector<int>& arr, int start, int a, int b) {
    int m = a + b;
    int i = start;
    while (i < (int)arr.size()) {
        if (i % m < a) {
            set<int> used;
            for (int j = i - 1; i - j <= a && j >= 0; j--) {
                used.insert(arr[j]);
            }
            int j = 0;
            while (i % m != a && i < (int)arr.size()) {
                while (used.count(j)) {
                    j++;
                }
                used.insert(j);
                arr[i] = j;
                i++;
                j++;
            }
        } else {
            arr[i] = arr[i - 1];
            i++;
        }
    }
}

int count(const vector<int>& arr, int l, int r) {
    set<int> seen;
    for (int i = l; i < r; i++) {
        seen.insert(arr[i]);
    }
    return seen.size();
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l--;
    int m = a + b;
    int cut = l / m * m;
    l -= cut;
    r -= cut;
    if (r > m * 3) {
        r = r % m + m * 3;
    }
    vector<int> arr(r);
    for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
        arr[i] = i;
    }
    build(arr, a, a, b);
    int ans = count(arr, l, r);
    for (int i = a; i < a + b && i < r && b < r; i++) {
        arr[i] = arr[b];
    }
    build(arr, a + b, a, b);
    ans = min(ans, count(arr, l, r));
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
